articles.summary: Never miss a critical contract deadline again. Set up custom alerts on any View, verify AI answers with paragraph-level citations in Word, and configure SSO without a support ticket. This release lets you configure custom email alerts on any saved View, trace AI-generated answers to source paragraphs in the Word Add-in, and set up SSO directly from Account Settings - no engineering required.
articles.title: 🚀 Product Update: Configurable Alerts + Word Add-in Citations
